text:
alexa: @here Harbor-3 (model_id=harbor-3) is GA on Hosted API — streaming v3 and tool-calling v3 enabled across regions. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/harbor-3 :tada:

alexa: Minimal example:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"harbor-3","input":"Summarize today's deploys","stream":true,"tool_call":true}'
```

mike: Note: `tool_input` renamed -> `tool_args`. Strict output schema enforced; non-conforming results fall back to text. Migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/migrate/tools-v2-to-v3

alexa: Old streaming SDK v1 deprecation window: 90 days. Please migrate to streaming v3.

infra: Canary deployed to us-west-2 at 1815004350, monitoring latency and gpu utilization.

deploy-bot: deploy: harbor-3-stream-v3 canary rolled (us-west-2) 5s ago 5 no early errors reported.

support: Added KB "Harbor-3 GA: quick fixes" and canned replies. Escalation tag: #harbor-3-ga.

alexa: Defaults to add to docs: 200 concurrent streams/org, 65k tokens per stream. Contact support for increases.

mike: Dedicated/private customers can pin variants via Console -> Settings -> Models -> Pin or API header `x-redwood-model: harbor-2@<version>`.

alexa: Thanks all. Post-GA sync 14:00 PT. Ping me for urgent items.
